messages:
emma-customer: hey team, our production lambda (eu-west-1) started returning 401 invalid_api_key for Redwood calls after yesterday's secret rotation. No code changes. Anyone seen this pattern?

sara-support: thanks for the report — can you paste the exact error and a minimal repro? is it gateway 401 or API response body says invalid_api_key? :thinking:

emma-customer: Response body: `{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"API key invalid or expired\"}`. Happens in a background job using the Node SDK. Local testing with my dev key works. It only fails with the rotated production key.

mike-se: can you share how you're loading the key in the lambda? env var, secret manager, mounted file? small code snippet helps.

emma-customer: we read from env: `const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;` then `client = new Redwood({ apiKey: API_KEY })`. We store secret in Secrets Manager and populate env via terraform: `secret_string = jsonencode({ key = var.redwood_key })` — not sure if tf adds newline.

raj-infra: deploy-bot shows the rotation job ran at 1778889000 and updated the secret. logs: `rotate-secret lambda-updater: wrote secret to sm://prod/redwood-key v3`. No errors.

mike-se: quick sanity check: can you echo the env var value length or wrap it in delimiters to see invisible chars? e.g. `console.log(\">\" + process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY + \"<\", process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY.length)`

emma-customer: ran that in a new deployment: output: `>sk-live_ABC123==\n< 25`. It literally includes a `\\n` at the end. :facepalm:

sara-support: that explains the invalid_api_key — keys must match exactly. Many SDKs/servers treat trailing whitespace as part of the token. Quick workaround: trim at startup `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY?.trim()` and redeploy.

mike-se: for a reproducible curl check from inside the lambda container (or local): `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\"" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models` — if you include quotes around header value you can see the trailing newline/space in debug. Or simpler: `echo -n "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | od -c`

emma-customer: trimmed and redeployed, all green. Thanks. Will rotate back to the new secret after fixing the Terraform step.

raj-infra: root cause: terraform `chomp`/jsonencode interaction + manual paste in CI added newline. We'll add validation in the deployer: check for leading/trailing whitespace and fail the rotation if present. Also filing a small infra task to sanitize before writing secrets to SM.

sara-support: noted — I'll add a KB blurb: "401 after rotation? Check for hidden newline/whitespace in secret values; try trimming or validate secret length/hex pattern." :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rotation-checker: new check queued — validate-secret-format prod/redwood-key (results pending)

emma-customer: thanks team! saving me a lot of hair-pulling.
